title.narrative: Dhaka and Western Zone Transmission Grid Expansion Project

description.narrative: The proposed project builds upon ADB's strong and sustained work in the power sector of Bangladesh. Complementing the investment in the recently-approved Southwest Transmission Grid Expansion Project and Rupsha 800-Megawatt Combined Cycle Power Plant in the southwest region, the project will focus on addressing some of the remaining deficiencies in the transmission system to enhance power transfer capacity to the load centers in the southern and western zones. These interventions will also strengthen in-country power transfer capacity for increased cross-border power trade with India. In addition, the project will develop the capacity of PGCB in financial management, and in drone utilization to improve operations efficiency. The project is aligned with the Energy Policy of ADB and the priorities of ADB's country partnership strategy for Bangladesh, 2016-2020. The project also supports operational priorities of ADB's Strategy 2030: (i) addressing poverty and inequality through modern energy access; (ii) tackling climate change, building climate and disaster resilience; (iii) accelerating progress in gender equality; and (iv) accelerating governance and institutional capacity.

description.narrative: Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: Transmission system in Greater Dhaka expanded Indicator: 11 km of 132 kV cable from Rampura to Basundhara constructed and commissioned (RFI B) Progress/Status: 11.50 km 132 kV UGTL commissioned in June, 2025 Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in Greater Dhaka expanded Indicator: 5.5 km of 400 kV and 230 KV Lines constructed and commissioned, comprising-
(i) LILO of 400kV Ghorashal - Purbachal double circuit line at Kaliganj (1 km), (ii) LILO of 400kV Ghorashal - Purbachal double circuit line and 230kV Bashundhara- Purbachal double circuit line at Purbachal (1 km), and
(iii) LILO of Tongi - Ghorashal 230kV double circuit line at Kaliganj (3.5 km)
(2018 baseline: 0) (RFI B) Progress/Status: Contract Awarded and implementation work ongoing. Physical progress 68%. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in Greater Dhaka expanded Indicator: Two indoor GIS substations with a capacity of 4,450 MVA constructed and commissioned at Kaliganj (400/230 kV), Purbachal (400/230/132 kV) Progress/Status: Two contracts are awarded and implementation work ongoing. Physical progress 30% and 42% respectively. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in western zone expanded Indicator: (i) Ten 132/33 kV substations constructed and commissioned, comprising GIS substations with a total capacity of 1,840 MVA at Bhanga, Domar, Hatibandha, Jhalokathi, Maheshpur, Monirampur, Meherpur, Phultola, Shibchar and Pirojpur; and (ii) four GIS bay extensions constructed and commissioned at the existing Purbasadipur substation plus 16 AIS bay extensions constructed and commissioned at existing substations in Kaliganj, Satkhira, Kushtia, Bagerhat, Bhandaria, Gopalganj, Niyamatpur, and Patnitala Progress/Status: A contract was awarded under P8 for construction of new substations at Bhola, Domar, Hatibandha, Jhalokathi,Shibchar, Bhanga & Pirojpur and bay extension at Purbasadipur, Gopalganj, Niyamatpur, Patnitala & Bhandaria. However, the contract had no progress and it has been terminated on 27/05/2024. Retendering has been initiated. ADB concurrence on FBER provided and approved in Power Grid board. However, since the lowest quoted price is beyond the DPP amount, special revision of the DPP due to foreign currency exchange rate fluctuation and internal budget reallocation are required before issuance of NoA. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in western zone expanded Indicator: 135 km of 230 kV lines constructed and commissioned, comprising (i) a 62 km line from Satkhir to Rupsha; (ii) a 46.5 km line from Purbasadipur to Domar; (iii) a 25 km line from Gopalganj (North) to Shibchar; and (iv) two LILO connections with a total length of 1.5 km at Bhola and Rupsha substations (RFI B) Progress/Status: Contracts awarded and implementation work ongoing. Physical progress 90% Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in western zone expanded Indicator: 233 km of 132 kV lines constructed and commissioned, comprising (i) a 35 km line from Domar to Hatibandha; (ii) a 28 km line from Kaliganj to Maheshpur; (iii) a 33 km line from Satkhir to Manirampur; (iv) a 48 km line from Kushtia to Meherpur; (v) a 49.5 km line from Bagerhat to Pirojpur-Bhandaria; (vi) a 32.5 km line from Niyamatpur to Patnitala; and (vii) five LILO connections with a total length of 7.0 km at Rupsha, Bhanga, Jhalokathi, and Phultola substations (RFI B) Progress/Status: Contracts awarded and implementation work ongoing. Physical progress 88% Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission system in western zone expanded Indicator: Two GIS substations with a total capacity of 1,230 MVA constructed and commissioned at Bhola (230/33 kV) and Rupsha (230/132/33 kV), and two bay extensions constructed and commissioned at the existing AIS substation at Satkhira Progress/Status: Contract awarded under P7 for construction of substations at Phultola, Rupsha, Monirumpur, Maheshpur & Meherpur and bay extension at Satkhira, Kaliganj, Kushita & Bagerhat. Implementation work is ongoing and current physical progress is 60%. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Institutional capacity of PGCB strengthened Indicator: At least 20% of technical staff employed in the drone inspection center are women Progress/Status: 21 Power Grid officials have been trained under Drone Procurement package and out of them 04 are women Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Not applicable

Output: Institutional capacity of PGCB strengthened Indicator: Drone inspection center established within the Operation and Maintenance Department of PGCB Progress/Status: Consultant for Drone procurement assumed responsibilities in Dec 2021. Drone contract was awarded on 18 Jan 2024.
Drone inspection center commissioned 23/12/2024. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: Not applicable Baseline year: 2018 Baseline value: Not applicable Target year: 2026 Target value: Not applicable
Reliability and efficiency of electricity supply in Greater Dhaka and western zone of Bangladesh improved

Carbon dioxide emissions reduced by 455,785 tons per year as a result of reduced transmission losses (RFI A) Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: Achievement status will be computed at the PCR stage, as PGCB annual report is yet to report CO2 emission reduction. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB
Transmission loss reduced to 2.5% Progress/Status: Output yet to achieve. Transmission Loss for FY 2024-25: 3.30% Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Occurrence of power outages reduced to not more than 15 annually Achievement: 60 Progress/Status: Output yet to achieve. Occurrences of power outage attributed to transmission system was 103 in FY2022 (96 partial grid failures were attributed to trouble in grid substation equipment; 7 partial grid failure were attributed to transmission line faults). FY 2023-24 data is yet to be reported. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB, PGCB'S environment monitoring reports
